Through his paternal lineage, he is the great-grandson of Harold Watkins, the first African-American fire chief of the Detroit Fire Department. He was raised in the Bond Hill neighborhood of Cincinnati and attended Cincinnati College Preparatory Academy and Purcell Marian High School. He registered his YouTube channel in 2016 and began consistent livestreaming in December 2017, averaging about 10 concurrent viewers by 2020. During COVID-19 in 2020, a clip was reposted by WorldStarHipHop, causing conflict with his mother; he moved to Detroit to live with his father and began livestreaming full-time with a PS4 camera, sharing a bedroom with his uncle.

name: Adin Ross
milestone_by_age_26: Trending #make2kfunagain worldwide on Twitter in November 2020 at age 20, gaining over 1 million Twitch followers by early 2021 with approximately 30,000 live viewers per stream, and having #FreeAdin trend on Twitter in April 2021; currently age 25 with 7 million Twitch followers and 4.61 million YouTube subscribers.
early_history_summary: Adin David Ross was born to Jewish parents in Boca Raton, Florida. He moved to New York City briefly, then to Three Rivers, California. He began regularly streaming on Twitch while living with his sister Naomi, initially streaming NBA 2K games. He joined an NBA 2K group called Always Excelling and met basketball player Bronny James through it, gaining popularity by playing NBA 2K20 with James and doing wager matches. In 2020, LeBron James joined a call during a stream with Bronny. In November 2020, his #make2kfunagain hashtag became the most popular worldwide on Twitter, and he started hosting 'e-date' streams that drove further growth.

Moved to New York City briefly, then to Three Rivers, California. Family financial background is not documented in reviewed sources.
